description: This file manages bundled channel configurations, including building maps of runtime schemas and config schemas, reading plugin data, and exporting functions to access these maps.

methods.name: buildBundledChannelMaps
methods.description: Constructs maps of channel runtime schemas and config schemas from plugin data and metadata.

methods.name: readBundledChannelPlugins
methods.description: Retrieves the list of bundled channel plugins, handling potential errors during import.

methods.name: getBundledChannelMaps
methods.description: Returns cached or newly built maps of bundled channel data.

methods.name: getBundledChannelRuntimeMap
methods.description: Exports the runtime map of bundled channels.

methods.name: getBundledChannelConfigSchemaMap
methods.description: Exports the config schema map of bundled channels.
